description:
W6 showed that `benchbox explorer build --help` still documents
`manifest.json`, but the current pipeline intentionally deletes legacy JSON
manifests and emits `results.duckdb` plus copied bundles. This creates a
stale contract for anyone building a local Explorer snapshot.

anti_patterns.dont: reintroduce manifest.json only to satisfy help text

preserves.behavior: The pipeline continues to delete stale legacy JSON artifacts.

verifications.description: Explorer build help no longer promises removed manifest output.
verifications.expected: help documents results.duckdb, results_schema.json, and copied bundles only

work_units.notes:
W1 audit evidence:
- `uv run -- benchbox explorer build --help` still says `--output` is for "generated artifacts (manifest,
  details, duckdb)" and lists `manifest.json` as a navigation index.
- `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/pipeline.py` is the source of truth for current behavior: it deletes legacy
  `benchmarks/`, `details/`, `compare/`, `manifest.json`, `meta_leaderboard.json`, `short_ids.json`, and
  `results_schema.json` before rebuilding. `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/duckdb_builder.py` then writes the
  current outputs: `results.duckdb`, auxiliary `results_schema.json`, and copied bundles under
  `bundles/{result_id}.json`.
- `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/contract.py` and `results-explorer/scripts/explorer-build-contract.mjs`
  validate only the command and required flags; they do not encode the expected outputs or removed legacy outputs.
- `cd results-explorer && npm run test -- explorer-build-contract` currently fails with "No test files found";
  the existing terminating contract validator is `cd results-explorer && node scripts/validate-explorer-build-contract.mjs`.
- Stale docs found in `docs/development/browser-test-architecture.md` (`results.duckdb` + manifest artifacts) and
  `docs/reference/threat-model.md` (public read models and tampering risks still name manifest/detail JSONs).
  Older strategy prose in `docs/development/benchbox-results-platform-strategy.md` intentionally records the migration
  history and should be left alone unless W2 needs an explicit historical note.
work_units.summary: Audit explorer build help, contract metadata, and docs for stale JSON outputs
Update help/docs/tests to match the DuckDB-only read model
